scope: Gmail incoming message filter label actions and full body query matching
implemented: All criteria are conjunctive; recipient criteria cover To/Cc/Bcc; subjects normalize case and whitespace.
Query and negated query search complete decoded MIME bodies, excluding attachment contents and HTML script/style text.
Label actions apply to native insert and import before history/watch notifications, preserving existing thread siblings.
Drafts and sends bypass incoming filter classification.
Malformed field types and invalid label actions fail atomically; saved query strings are permissive, and invalid operator terms do not match without blocking delivery.

flow: Create filter through Settings; import matching and unmatched mail through native API.
Confirm label folder and unread Inbox counts.
Edit exclusion criterion at 390px, import excluded mail and verify unchanged Inbox/UNREAD labels.
Reload and verify saved rule, exact protected-thread message, other account settings and label membership.

limits: Filter forwarding and automatic forwarding delivery remain unimplemented.
This evidence does not establish full Gmail frontend parity.

review_fixes.details: Direct live-provider checks supersede the earlier strict rejection approach: Gmail accepts malformed query strings. Nonmatching invalid terms now preserve OR/negation semantics and cannot crash delivery; invalid field types remain rejected or safely ignored in legacy snapshots.
